subject: general
question: In February 2022, Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment launched the SMILE (Support for Marginalised Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) scheme in how many cities?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment** launched the SMILE (Support for Marginalized Individuals for Livelihood and Enterprise) **scheme in 10 cities in February 2022**
 
• SMILE stands for Support for Marginalized Individuals for livelihood and Enterprise.
 
• The Smile Scheme is launched by the union minister of Social justice and Empowerment, Dr. Virendra Singh in Feb 2022.
 
• The scheme targets the groups involved in the act of begging especially the transgender community.
 
• The scheme ensures necessary legal protection, and social security for the targeted groups.
 
• The budget allocated for the scheme is Rs.365 crores over a period of 5 years. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sweekruti Scheme was also introduced for the promotion of transgender and equality for transgenders in the Odisha government.
 
• There are schemes like Shelter homes for transgender persons in Gujarat under which people from the community would be provided with basic necessities of food and shelter.
